rdfs:label: Country
rdfs:comment: A country — a sovereign nation-state or territory.
notes: Subclass of `urn:solid:Place` (via `schema:AdministrativeArea`). Put the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in `schema:identifier` (or `dcterms:identifier` via `urn:solid:identifier`, as in the example). For sub-national regions (US states, provinces) use `schema:State` or `schema:AdministrativeArea`; for supranational bodies such as the EU, use `schema:Organization` or `schema:AdministrativeArea`.

examples.title: A country with an ISO code

history.note: Corrected guidance on sub-national/supranational regions; notes now name the identifier property used in the example.
